verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a structured data extractor where you define your own target JSON schema and Unstructured extracts values from source files into that shape, as consistent JSON matching your fields (docs-3, docs-26, docs-34). Developers can call the platform through the Python SDK and REST API (docs-4, docs-23). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of schema validation guarantees or error handling, evidence that the extractor itself is invoked via the SDK/API rather than only in workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
